$comment: Recorded exceptions to the registry's lifecycle gates (registry/README.md, "Exceptions"; tools/registry-gates.ts). Each waives one rule for one version of one extension, by an owner's decision, until the condition it names; the gate fails once the rule passes, so that the exception is removed. Nothing of Ratified can be waived.

exceptions.decision: Owner decision with FLR-T-8.3 (merged 8cc76a9): FS_furniture 0.1.0 is published at Release Candidate with no implementation listed; the conformance oracle passes its suite but wrote its expected outputs, so it is not evidence.
exceptions.until: D3 Floorspec's engine passes the FS_furniture 0.1.0 suite and is listed, with evidence, in registry/FS_furniture/extension.json.
